entities.summary: Leader of United States of America (1989–1993). 41st; Republican; VP under Reagan; Gulf War 1991 (liberated Kuwait); Cold War ended (USSR collapsed 1991, 'won' Cold War); 'New World Order'; broke tax pledge ('Read my lips'); lost 1992 (recession);
